source_text: Vocaverunt altare Witness — Testimonium. Pax restaurata. Unus Deus utriusque ripae. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: They-called altar Witness — Testimony. Peace restored. One God of-each bank. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[They named the altar Witness >> Bible:Joshua 22:34]]. Peace restored. One God on both banks. Amen.
